faq.q: Can clients use the portraits I create?
faq.a: Yes, if the person in the portrait agrees to that use. Review the final image before putting it on a client site or in a presentation.

faq.q: Do I need a photographer for professional headshots?
faq.a: No. Upload a face photo and choose a professional style. You can make team headshots without booking a photographer or learning editing software.

faq.q: How do I make a professional headshot with AI?
faq.a: Upload a clear, approved photo of each person and choose a professional background. Review the finished headshot before downloading it.

faq.q: Can I use photos my team already approved?
faq.a: Yes. Use only photos and likenesses your teammates have approved for this purpose. Review each result with them before publishing.

faq.q: What kind of source photo works best?
faq.a: Choose a sharp, front-facing photo with even light and a clear view of the face. This helps the finished portrait look like the person.

faq.q: Can I try different backgrounds and crops?
faq.a: Yes. Try different professional backgrounds and crops, then choose one style for the team. You can make new versions without another photo session.

faq.q: How do I add a new teammate later?
faq.a: Upload an approved photo of the new teammate and reuse your team’s background and crop. Check that the new portrait fits beside the others.

faq.q: Can I make matching headshots for my team?
faq.a: Yes. Use the same background, lighting, and crop for each person. Your team portraits can look consistent without scheduling one studio day.

faq.q: Will an AI headshot still look like me?
faq.a: It should. Start with a clear photo and compare the result with the person before publishing. Make another version if the face looks wrong.

faq.q: Where can I use professional headshots?
faq.a: Use approved headshots on your team page, LinkedIn, speaker bios, and proposals. Get each person’s permission for where their portrait appears.

faq.q: How much does an AI headshot cost?
faq.a: One headshot costs 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600.
